functions.name: deduire_stock_apres_vente
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduire_stock_apres_vente()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.produits
  set stock_quantite = stock_quantite - new.quantite,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = new.produit_id;

  if (select stock_quantite from public.produits where id = new.produit_id) < 0 then
    raise exception 'Stock insuffisant pour ce produit';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles
        where id = auth.uid()
          and role = 'admin'
    );
$function$
